SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2002', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which counties in New York have the highest median household income?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did New York households on full service pay per kilowatt hour in 2020, on average?

SELECT round(100 * sum(try_cast(revenues AS double)) / sum(try_cast(sales AS double)), 2) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' AND column06 = 'NY'
Where is sub-award work carried out most, state by state?

SELECT place_of_perform_state_name, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE coalesce(place_of_perform_state_name, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many corrective action plans are on file with the audit clearinghouse?
Which towns in Wisconsin have the most eligible voters?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_mcd WHERE lntitle = 'Total' AND geoname LIKE '%, Wisconsin' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many master reactions does Rhea define?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_directions
Which employers' benefit plans covered the most participants in plan year 2000?

SELECT sponsor_dfe_name, sum(try_cast(tot_partcp_boy_cnt AS double)) AS participants FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500 WHERE substr(form_plan_year_begin_date, 1, 4) = '2000' AND sponsor_dfe_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the total number of jobs based in San Francisco County in 2021?
SELECT sum(c000) AS total FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'ca' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2021 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '06075'
Which countries outside the United States produce the most patented inventions?
SELECT raw_country, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country <> 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies filed an electric quarterly report for the second quarter of 2016?
SELECT count(DISTINCT company_id_ferc) AS companies FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_quarterly_identity WHERE year_quarter = '2016q2'
Which SEC forms were filed most often in 2025?
SELECT form, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings WHERE substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many insurance complaints did Texas receive each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(received_date, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints WHERE substr(received_date, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What is the molecular formula of caffeine?
SELECT m.c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = m.c0 WHERE t.c1 = 'Caffeine'
How many judges were confirmed by the Senate in 2014?
SELECT count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2014'
Which states produced the most utility-scale solar power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.SUN-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Medicare-enrolled hospitals have a private equity owner?
SELECT count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_all_owners WHERE private_equity_company_owner = 'Y'
How has the consumer price index for electricity changed over the last ten years?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SEHF01' AND period = 'M13' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
How many water discharge inspections were carried out by EPA itself rather than a state?
SELECT count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections WHERE state_epa_flag = 'E'
Where were the most public schools closed in 2022-23?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS closed FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE sy_status_text = 'Closed' AND school_year = '2022-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Form 4 reports did Tesla insiders file in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE issuertradingsymbol = 'TSLA' AND document_type = '4' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2022'
In which states were home loans largest on average in 2023?

SELECT state_code, round(avg(try_cast(loan_amount AS double))) AS avg_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people killed in 2022 crashes were thrown out of their vehicle?
SELECT count(*) AS ejected FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' AND ejection IN ('1', '2', '3')
In which states do Davis-Bacon determinations set the highest carpenter wages?

SELECT substr(wd_number, 1, 2) AS state, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE classification LIKE 'CARPENTER%' AND try_cast(rate AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many categories of federal award does USAspending distinguish?
How much did the federal government owe in 1790?
SELECT try_cast(debt_outstanding_amt AS double) AS debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_outstanding WHERE record_date = '1790-01-01'
How many clinicians earned a perfect MIPS score of 100?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_ec_score_file WHERE try_cast(final_mips_score AS double) = 100
How has Veterans Affairs contract spending in Florida changed from 2018 to 2025?

SELECT action_date_fiscal_year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'FL' AND action_date_fiscal_year BETWEEN '2018' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
How many state law sections were last amended in 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE cast(last_amended_year AS varchar) = '2025'
How do registered clinical studies stand: completed, recruiting, terminated or other?
SELECT overall_status, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal contract actions went to companies in Buffalo in fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(recipient_city_name) = 'BUFFALO' AND recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025'
How many jobs vanished between February and April 2020?
SELECT period, value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES0000000001' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period IN ('M02', 'M04') ORDER BY period
Which California counties had the most fatal crashes in 2020?
SELECT countyname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'California' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the average U.S. residential electricity price change from 2004 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.US-RES.A' AND period IN ('2004', '2024') ORDER BY 1
How many applications in the examination file went on to issue as patents?
SELECT count(*) AS granted FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE patent_number <> ''
How many students were enrolled in U.S. public schools in 2024-25?
SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total'
How many generating technologies does the Annual Technology Baseline cover?
SELECT count(DISTINCT technology_alias) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_atb_atbe
How are hazardous waste generators split between large, small and very small quantity?
SELECT hreport_universe_record, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
For how many currencies does the Treasury publish reporting rates?
SELECT count(DISTINCT country_currency_desc) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange
How much did Medicaid pay for Humira prescriptions in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND state = 'XX' AND product_name LIKE 'HUMIRA%'
Which nursing home deficiencies are cited most often?
SELECT deficiency_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE deficiency_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were more patent applications filed in 2015 or in 2023?
SELECT substr(filing_date, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE substr(filing_date, 6, 4) IN ('2015', '2023') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
